title: senecio erucifolius subsp. grandidentatus
intro: Senecio erucifolius subsp. grandidentatus, commonly known as the Grand-leaved Ragwort, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family Asteraceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. Senecio erucifolius subsp. grandidentatus has been reported to exhibit potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, due to its ability to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, such as erucifolin and grandidentatol, which are believed to be responsible for its therapeutic actions.
